column3: NKJV has “with My Father … with your father,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “with the Father … what you heard from the father.”
NKJV has “If you were … you would do,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “If you are Abraham's children, do the works of Abraham.”
NKJV has “He is your God,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “He is our God.” “Glorify” is rendered “honor.”
NKJV includes “going through the midst of them, and so passed by,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text ends with “went out of the temple.”
